passages.text: Behold, Thou hast made my days old, and they pass away, and how, I know not.

Woe is me, that do not even know, what I know not. Behold, O my God, before Thee I lie not; but as I speak, so is my heart. Thou shalt light my candle; Thou, O Lord my God, wilt enlighten my darkness.
passages.note: Confusion and not-knowing; honest hope for light
